doc: Waymo Open Dataset v1.4.3 frames behind the corpus: per extraction folder, the (segment, frame) pairs dumped by scripts/waymo_extract_perception.py (identifiers only; obtain the data from Waymo under its licence). Corpus scenes are 4-frame temporal chunks '<segment>#c<k>' of the extracted_all_* folders (scripts/export_filter_features_overnight.py --chunk 4); extracted_large is the Stage-1 training stream.
